judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing the spec update and the failing acceptance test, completely failing to modify `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to implement the fix. Because the production code was untouched, the newly added test in `src/orchestration/onErrorNonErrorRejection.acceptance.test.ts` fails immediately and `npm test` does not pass. Furthermore, the candidate explicitly declared CHANGELOG edits out of scope in `.lore/dod.md`, violating the fourth acceptance criterion which requires updating the CHANGELOG. Finally, the candidate placed the test in a separate new file and left behind `.lore/dod.md`, whereas the reference added the test case directly to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
